transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’m useless now and just letting everyone down since my fall. I had an unexpected knee procedure after slipping on a trail, and since then, I feel like I've just been a burden to everyone who used to count on me.
How long have you been experiencing these feelings, and have you also lost interest in the activities you normally enjoy?

These feelings have been with me steadily for about a month now, starting shortly after my knee procedure. I’ve completely lost interest in the things I used to love, like my financial workshops, senior hikes, and even tending to my tomato plants, and now I just sit in front of the TV feeling blank.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns or your daily energy levels since your knee procedure?

Yes, both have been absolutely terrible. I lie awake for hours worrying, wake up constantly, and finally pop awake at 4 or 5 a.m. unable to fall back asleep. On top of that, my energy is completely drained; my body feels heavy, and even simple chores feel like climbing a mountain.
Sometimes when people feel like a burden, they might have thoughts of wishing they weren't around anymore. Have you experienced any thoughts of self-harm or suicide?

Lately, on my really low days, I do catch myself thinking it wouldn't be so bad if I just didn't wake up in the morning. I sometimes imagine how much quieter everything would be for everyone if I just slipped away, though I haven't made any concrete plans to do anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight, or has it been harder than usual for you to concentrate and make decisions lately?

Yes, my appetite has vanished and I often have to remind myself to eat, usually just picking at some toast or yogurt in the afternoon. My mind also feels incredibly foggy lately, making me lose my train of thought and feel completely overwhelmed by simple decisions like choosing what to wear.
Have you ever experienced a period in your life before this knee surgery where you felt similarly depressed, lost interest in your hobbies, or struggled with sleep?

No, I've never felt anything like this before. I have always been a very active, on-the-go person until this knee surgery changed everything. This is the first time in my life I've ever struggled with my mood like this.
Would you say this low mood and lack of interest are present nearly every day, lasting most of the day, or do they tend to come and go depending on your activities or who is around?

Yes, it is pretty much constant every single day rather than coming and going. It feels like a heavy cloud hanging over me all day long, regardless of what is happening around me or who tries to reach out. It just doesn't seem to lift at all.
